PropertyType.description:
Property type -- the complete vocabulary the authored eligibility corpus checks against
(this pack's policies/standard.yaml: the DSCR-HIGH-LTV-PROPERTY-TYPE eligible
set + DSCR-PROPERTY-TYPE-CLTV overlay set), not a guess.
PropertyType.title: PropertyType

description:
Incoming DSCR loan application.

This is the trigger that initiates an eligibility investigation. Its fields carry the pack's
Entity.field names, which the policies/ rules read directly; a field under any other name is
not read.

program_id.description: The Acra program applied for, one of the pack manifest's programs; None takes the manifest's default_program
program_id.title: Program Id

RatioSet.total_monthly_obligation_usd.description: Monthly PITIA (principal, interest, taxes, insurance, assoc. dues)
RatioSet.total_monthly_obligation_usd.title: Ratioset.Total Monthly Obligation Usd

RatioSet.reserves_months.description: Months of PITIA reserves the borrower can show
RatioSet.reserves_months.title: Ratioset.Reserves Months

LoanCore.dscr_qualification_method.description: e.g. 'full', 'no_ratio' -- 'no_ratio' is NOT inferable from a missing DSCR
LoanCore.dscr_qualification_method.title: Loancore.Dscr Qualification Method

Borrower.is_entity_borrower_1.description: Only meaningful when Borrower.entity_type != 'individual': is the LLC/entity listed as Borrower 1 on all loan documents?
Borrower.is_entity_borrower_1.title: Borrower.Is Entity Borrower 1

Borrower.entity_documents_complete.description: Only meaningful when Borrower.entity_type != 'individual': Operating Agreement/Bylaws, Articles of Organization/Incorporation, and Certificate of Good Standing all on file.
Borrower.entity_documents_complete.title: Borrower.Entity Documents Complete

TitleInformation.has_related_party_trans.description: Title review found the subject property transferred more than once among the entity and its guarantors.
TitleInformation.has_related_party_trans.title: Titleinformation.Has Related Party Transfers

UnderwritingSummary.duplicate_ssn_cleare.description: The Stage 1 duplicate-SSN check ran and any duplicate found was withdrawn or declined before this loan proceeds.
UnderwritingSummary.duplicate_ssn_cleare.title: Underwritingsummary.Duplicate Ssn Cleared

UnderwritingSummary.broker_nmls_verified.description: Broker's NMLS credentials verified (1003 p.4 / NMLS consumer access).
UnderwritingSummary.broker_nmls_verified.title: Underwritingsummary.Broker Nmls Verified

UnderwritingSummary.loan_officer_nmls_ve.description: Broker's Loan Officer's NMLS credentials verified.
UnderwritingSummary.loan_officer_nmls_ve.title: Underwritingsummary.Loan Officer Nmls Verified

SubjectProperty.is_listed_for_sale.description: Refinance-only listing check: is the subject property currently listed for sale (e.g. via Redfin)?
SubjectProperty.is_listed_for_sale.title: Subjectproperty.Is Listed For Sale

CondoProject.hoa_reserves_adequate.description: Condo/condotel only: HOA budget and reserve fund reviewed as adequate against program guidelines. No numeric reserve standard is published in the source corpus (either program's consolidated guidelines) -- this is the AM's own budget-review determination, not a computed threshold.
CondoProject.hoa_reserves_adequate.title: Condoproject.Hoa Reserves Adequate

CondoProject.hoa_litigation_pending.description: Condo/condotel only: active or pending litigation against the HOA/condo association.
CondoProject.hoa_litigation_pending.title: Condoproject.Hoa Litigation Pending

LoanCore.prepayment_penalty_structure.description: Selected PPP structure: 'unspecified' (not stated; denies in the states with a buyout rule), 'no_prepay', '5yr_5pct_fixed', '5yr_step', '4yr_5pct_fixed', '4yr_3pct_fixed', '3yr_5pct_fixed', '3yr_3pct_fixed', '2yr_3pct_fixed', or '1yr_3pct_fixed'.
LoanCore.prepayment_penalty_structure.title: Loancore.Prepayment Penalty Structure

SubjectProperty.number_of_units.description: 1-4; distinguishes single-unit/Residential-1-2 state PPP carve-outs from the broader Residential-1-4 ones, and Platinum Select's two-unit limit. Required and never null: 1 for a single-unit property type, and stated by the application for a 2-4 unit property, since a null would leave the rules that gate on it unevaluated and the loan allowed.
SubjectProperty.number_of_units.title: Subjectproperty.Number Of Units

LoanCore.note_rate_percent.description: Note rate, percent (e.g. 7.5). Only needed for the Illinois >$250k/individual/>8% PPP rule.
LoanCore.note_rate_percent.title: Loancore.Note Rate Percent

LoanCore.channel.description: 'wholesale' or 'correspondent'; 'unspecified' is held to Correspondent limits.
LoanCore.channel.title: Loancore.Channel

CreditReport.housing_history_rating.description: Worst 12-month housing rating: '0x30x12' (no lates), '1x30x12', '0x60x12', '0x90x12', '0x120x12', or 'unspecified'. An enum, since the rules match these spellings exactly and another spelling would skip them.
CreditReport.housing_history_rating.title: Creditreport.Housing History Rating

CreditReport.mortgage_0x30x24.description: No 30-day mortgage late in 24 months (escrow waiver).
CreditReport.mortgage_0x30x24.title: Creditreport.Mortgage 0X30X24

SubjectProperty.has_current_lease.description: A current lease agreement is on file (cash-out refinance).
SubjectProperty.has_current_lease.title: Subjectproperty.Has Current Lease

Borrower.has_short_sale_dil_or_modificat.title: Borrower.Has Short Sale Dil Or Modification

Borrower.months_since_short_sale_dil_or_.title: Borrower.Months Since Short Sale Dil Or Modification

CreditReport.tradelines_meet_requirement.description: 2 tradelines with 24 months history or 3 with 12 months, where 2 or fewer scores are reported.
CreditReport.tradelines_meet_requirement.title: Creditreport.Tradelines Meet Requirement

SubjectProperty.ownership_months.description: Months the borrower has owned the subject (refinance).
SubjectProperty.ownership_months.title: Subjectproperty.Ownership Months

SubjectProperty.is_mixed_use.description: Mixed use, adult care or assisted living.
SubjectProperty.is_mixed_use.title: Subjectproperty.Is Mixed Use

LoanCore.is_interest_only_10_40.description: The Interest Only 10 Yr / 40 Year Term product.
LoanCore.is_interest_only_10_40.title: Loancore.Is Interest Only 10 40

SubjectProperty.listed_for_sale_last_6_m.description: Listed for sale in the six months before the application date.
SubjectProperty.listed_for_sale_last_6_m.title: Subjectproperty.Listed For Sale Last 6 Months
